name: Coordinator comments reach the assignee through review states
aliases: project membership coordinator owner comment author
summary: On an open assigned task, unconsumed plain comments return attention to the assignee across review states, including an integrated remainder, only while their author currently holds project owner/coordinator membership, an effective agent coordinator grant, or configured host operator authority through the existing principal map. Reserved review/integration/hand-back/checkpoint/receipt records never add comment attention. A valid assignee checkpoint or structured response consumes attention; own parent/sub-label progress stays quiet, closed tasks gain none and operator errors remain operator work. Work listings and HTTP next/worker wait share this decision and existing activity selection and stable wait markers; role grant/removal re-evaluates earlier comments at read time and review/lifecycle facts and coordinator-wait trigger groups remain unchanged.
